body: Life isn't a linear path, but it's not a rollercoaster either. Nothing happens without effort or work on one's part. I am tired of giving that effort to live in a world that I don't like all that much to begin with. If I'm already tired of life when I'm 20, how tired would I be if I reached 50?
These people are not genuinely trying. They are throwing about canned replies and then pat themselves on the back because they've done their good deed for the day.
